skills.name: Whirlwind's Blessing
skills.utilitySummary: AoE 30m Slowed (-15% Move, -175 Atk Spd for 30s)
skills.description: Increases ally Attack Speed +250 and Move Speed +20% within 30m, and decreases enemy Attack Speed -175 and Move Speed -15% for 30s.

skills.name: Hollow Renewal
skills.utilitySummary: 30s Enemy Curse (2% on dmg taken → 4m AoE Gradual Recovery 5.5s)
skills.description: Enlightened Hollow Vitalism Mark (skill 9003166, buff 9001191): Calls forth energy from the land to curse an enemy for 30s. When receiving damage, the cursed enemy has a 2% chance to trigger Hollow Eruption (10s CD), releasing a 4m AoE healing wave that applies Gradual Recovery (5.5s HoT, scales with Healing Power / healing bonuses) to all allies of the caster.

skills.name: Abyssal Petrification
skills.description: Removes all debuffs and aggro from a selected target and protects them against all damage and harmful effects for 2s–6s, preventing movement or actions. Recasting on a petrified target reverses the effect.

skills.name: Defy Death
skills.description: Revives up to 6 allies within 6m (20m when consuming 6 Abyssal Charges). Additional Abyssal Charges increase revived Health and Mana. Can be used in combat.
